headline: Florida Southern beat Saint Leo and lead alone
dek: Saint Leo were the only side to have beaten Florida Southern this season, and Florida Southern have now beaten them back on a night when both of the sides level above them lost. They have won nine times and lost once, and their thirty goals are more than any other programme has scored.
displaced_by: Florida Southern beat Saint Leo while Tampa and Florida Tech both lost; the two no longer lead

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and both of those sides sit at the foot of the table.

wire.line: Florida Southern have now beaten the only side that beat them, and are the only programme still winning every conference match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result; Palm Beach Atlantic are party to all of them but Eckerd's home match of September 9.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored nine of Palm Beach Atlantic's seventeen goals this season, from 39 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Embry-Riddle have won six, drawn two and lost one, the defeat coming at home to Rollins on September 23.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 21 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Henry Obi has made 42 saves for Barry without yet keeping a clean sheet.

last_match.line: Saint Leo were the only side to have beaten Florida Southern; Florida Southern now lead the table alone, and Saint Leo are still without a conference win.

next_match.line: Florida Southern have won every match since their only defeat; Rollins come in off a loss at Lynn in which they did not score.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
